compose_land_verify_wall.problem: [VERIFY] 散落在 L-01…L-15 与 /land/s/power §2，无汇总视图，未证断言可能被当作已知或遗漏；核销若无出处与 L-05 v2 推理日志记录则无法审计。｜[VERIFY] markers sit across L-01…L-15 and /land/s/power §2 with no single view, so unproven claims risk being read as known or lost; clears without a source and an L-05 v2 reasoning-log entry cannot be audited.
do: ROUTE: /land/verify-wall only. Lazy route chunk via dynamic import(); not in the homepage entry chunk; no prefetch from homepage. Readers view; the clear action is writer-role only, enforced where writes land (API or CI), never by UI alone; reader DOM has no clear control.

HARVEST (build-time): scan only L-01…L-15 + power§2 (= /land/s/power §2) for literal [VERIFY] or [VERIFY:<key>]. Each hit → one candidate {plate, anchor, source_ref?, key|marker_ordinal} in a curator queue outside the wall (never rendered or exported); rescans dedupe. chip_opened is appended only when a curator supplies lint-clean claim_summary + needed_source. Out-of-scope hits are rejected and listed in an ingest report, never silently dropped or auto-rewritten.

ID: chip id always VW-<plate slug>-<sha1(plate|source_ref or anchor|key or marker_ordinal|cites)[:8]>; two markers in one item → two ids; a correction chip always gets a new id. Frozen at chip_opened. The source item's existing id goes in source_ref (Constraint Constellation joins on it). VW-PH-* reserved for placeholders.

APPEND-ONLY STORE: events chip_opened | chip_cleared | chip_marker_removed, each with seq + prev_hash; chip state = fold(events). No update or delete path, enforced by the store itself: a DB role with INSERT + SELECT only, or, if file/JSONL-backed (same store family as L-05 v2), a CI guard that rejects any diff altering or removing an existing line. Disputes and corrections = a new open chip with cites=<prior id>.
MARKER GONE: marker removed upstream with no source → append chip_marker_removed; status stays open. Removal ≠ clear.

LAMPS: open = hollow gold@30 ring ○ (lamp lit = source owed); cleared = solid ink ● + small 证 seal (lamp out); placeholder = dashed ring + copy.placeholder_badge (its S shows only in the grade field). Status is always text + glyph, never color-only.

CLEAR GATE: native <dialog> with <input type=url required> + <input type=date required>. source_url absolute https and external to GRAVITY; source_date ISO ≤ clear date. Missing or invalid → rejected, lamp stays lit, copy.clear_blocked.
L-05: an accepted clear mints exactly one verify_clear on the L-05 v2 reasoning log in the same transaction (see l05_hook); the cleared chip shows its L-05 entry ref.
GRADE: copy O/M/S/C from the source plate verbatim; the wall never assigns, upgrades or explains grades; placeholders carry S.

哨兵 BRIEF §6: a build-time id-only extractor emits brief_q_ids.json (array of id tokens; same charset, ≤32 chars); the BRIEF file is never shipped or imported into the route bundle. The read-only research-prompt rail at the wall foot reads only that file and lists ids; chip.brief_q_ref holds one id token; clicking an id filters linked chips.

PRINT DENSITY: plate trays L-01→L-15, power §2 last; chip ≤3 lines (id · plate · grade · lamp+status [· brief_q_ref] / claim_summary / needed_source · as_of [· disputed_by]); monospace ids; @media print hides controls, break-inside: avoid, footer carries as_of.

FILTER: plate rail (multi-select + All) × status rail open|cleared; per-plate open/cleared counts as text; state in URL ?plate=L-11,power-s2&status=open (ASCII slug power-s2, displayed 'power §2'); export honors filter; fully keyboard-reachable.

EXPORT MARKDOWN (founder): verify-wall_<as_of>_<plate slugs joined by '+' | all>_<status | all>.md; labels only from copy.<locale> (export_header, export_needs, export_src, export_as_of, export_l05, disputed_by) + standing notice; '## <plate>' groups, open first; '- [ ] <id> · <claim_summary> · {export_needs} <needed_source> · {export_as_of} <date>' / '- [x] … · {export_src} <source_url> (<source_date>) · {export_l05}'. Read-only, zero side effects, no HTML.
RENDER HYGIENE: source_url rendered as a plain link rel=noopener noreferrer; never fetched, previewed or unfurled; page makes same-origin requests only.
MOTION: one ink-fill of the ring ≤300ms on clear, opacity fade ≤150ms on filter change; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → fully static.
Q-*: any chip on a Q-* item renders text only + copy.quant_notice; quant refuse-list applies.

BILINGUAL + INHERIT: every user-facing string zh+en (copy.zh / copy.en identical keys); standing notice on wall, print and export. L-05 / L-01 河 PASTE remain binding as-is; the wall only reads plates and appends verify_clear.
dont: No price, PnL, order, position, LIVE, tips, 必赚, 10000x or buy/sell wording (nor zh 盈亏/价格/下单/实盘/荐股/稳赚/买入/卖出) in copy, chips, DOM text, export or verify_clear payloads.
No trading surface: no quotes, market feeds, instrument charts, exchange links, order tickets; for Q-*: no API-key input, no exchange login, no wallet connect.
No auto-clear: not by crawler, LLM, link-checker, rescan, bulk action, or marker disappearance.
No clear without BOTH source_url + source_date; no self-citation (/land/*, the wall, L-05, BRIEF files) as source_url; needed_source is a description, never a URL.
No delete, no edit-in-place, no cleared→open, no undo; no status beyond open|cleared.
No 哨兵 BRIEF §6 JSONL body in any field, tooltip, preview, bundle, download or export — ids only.
No plate outside L-01…L-15 + power§2; no L-00, no L-16+; no reads, writes or links into /field, /campus, /ethics.
No invented plate content, card ids, numbers, event dates or O/M/S/C meanings; no restating or overriding L-05 v2 / L-01 河 rules; no L-05 event type besides verify_clear.
No placeholder presented as real: never cleared, never in the default export, hidden on the production wall (dev/fixture preview only).

required.id: string; unique, immutable. Always VW-<plate slug>-<8 hex> (hash of plate | source_ref or anchor | key or marker_ordinal | cites); never the bare source item id. VW-PH-<nn> reserved for placeholder=true.
required.plate: allow-list enum L-01 … L-15 | power§2 (= /land/s/power §2; slug power-s2 in URL, id and filename; displayed 'power §2'). Anything else (L-00, L-16+, /field, /campus, /ethics, free text) → rejected at harvest and at write.
required.claim_summary: string 'zh｜en', ≤120 chars per side, curator-written before chip_opened; states WHAT needs checking, never a verdict; adds no fact beyond the plate marker; passes banned-term lint.
required.needed_source: string 'zh｜en', ≤80 chars per side, curator-written before chip_opened; kind of evidence that would clear it (primary text, official methodology note, dated record); never a URL.
required.status: enum open | cleared; default open; only transition open→cleared.
required.as_of: YYYY-MM-DD; date of the chip's latest event (open date while open; clear date when cleared).

required_iff_cleared.source_url: absolute https URL, external to GRAVITY (/land/*, internal hosts, L-05, BRIEF files rejected). Required iff status=cleared; absent while open. Stored and linked, never fetched.
required_iff_cleared.source_date: YYYY-MM-DD; source publication date (access date only if undated); source_date ≤ as_of; not in future. Required iff status=cleared; absent while open.

optional.grade: enum O | M | S | C — existing plate grade copied verbatim, meaning unchanged; absent if the plate has none; wall sets only S, only on placeholders.
optional.placeholder: bool, default false. true ⇒ grade=S AND id VW-PH-* AND status locked open AND copy.placeholder_badge (S only in the grade field) AND excluded from default export AND never reaches the L-05 hook.
optional.brief_q_ref: one 哨兵 BRIEF §6 question id token; 1–32 chars from [A-Za-z0-9._§-] (rejects braces, quotes, colons, whitespace, newlines = JSONL-body guard); non-placeholder values must be in brief_q_ids.json.
optional.source_ref: existing id of the source item (e.g. '<L-11 card id>'), copied verbatim; not unique (one item may hold several markers); join key for Constraint Constellation.
optional.cites: id of a prior chip this chip disputes or corrects; drives the derived disputed_by tag on the cited chip.

invariants: status=cleared ⇔ source_url AND source_date both present and valid.
Events are append-only (seq + prev_hash chain); displayed state = fold(events); nothing is overwritten or deleted.
disputed_by is derived at fold from chips whose cites = this id; never stored; status unchanged.
Q-* items: no field may hold a key, credential, account, wallet or exchange identifier.

l05_hook.target: L-05 v2 reasoning log; its entry shape and rules inherited unchanged (L-05 PASTE still binding).
l05_hook.trigger: writer's explicit open→cleared on a non-placeholder chip with valid source_url + source_date.
l05_hook.payload_rule: Map onto the existing L-05 v2 entry shape; a field L-05 v2 has no slot for stays on the wall — never alter L-05 v2. Payload passes the same banned-term lint and forbidden_fields check.
l05_hook.atomicity: chip_cleared + verify_clear commit in one transaction; L-05 append failure → whole clear rolls back, chip stays open, copy.clear_rollback shown.
l05_hook.idempotency: key = chip_id; at most one verify_clear per chip, ever; repeat clear → 409 + copy.already_cleared, no new entry.
l05_hook.correction: No reversal event. A wrong clear is corrected by a new open chip with cites=<old chip_id> (new id); fold derives a read-only copy.disputed_by tag on the old chip, whose status stays cleared and is never overwritten. The new chip's own later clear mints its own verify_clear.
l05_hook.backlink: Cleared chip shows its L-05 entry ref; export line ends with copy.export_l05.

acceptance: A01 Harvest parity: fixture with N [VERIFY] across L-01…L-15 + power§2 → N queue candidates, 0 chips before curation; curation fixture → exactly N chips, plate = source plate; rebuild → 0 new candidates or chips, identical id set.

A02 Scope: plate check is an allow-list enum {L-01…L-15, power§2} with no higher-number literal in code; fixture markers on L-00, L-16, /field, /campus, /ethics → 0 chips, listed in ingest report; grep of route src + data + export for L-16…L-99 = 0 hits (test/fixtures excluded).
A03 Marker removal fixture → chip_marker_removed appended, status still open, 0 L-05 writes.
A04 Clear gate: missing source_url, missing source_date, non-https, /land/* or L-05 URL, future or unparsable date → 422 each + copy.clear_blocked; chip stays open; 0 L-05 entries.
A05 Valid clear → status=cleared, as_of = clear date, exactly 1 verify_clear with matching chip_id; repeat → 409 + copy.already_cleared, still 1.
A06 Injected L-05 append failure → chip open, zero events added, no partial state, copy.clear_rollback shown.

A07 Append-only: any update/delete attempt on chips or events is rejected (API: 405; DB: UPDATE/DELETE permission denied; file/JSONL: CI fails on a diff touching an existing line); N appends + simulated restart/compaction → count ≥ N and prev_hash chain verifies.

A08 Placeholder chip: clear → 403 + copy.placeholder_locked, no L-05 write; absent from production wall and default export; copy.placeholder_badge rendered in dev preview, S only in grade field; id matches VW-PH-.

A09 BRIEF: brief_q_ids.json is a flat array of strings, each matching the id charset and ≤32 chars, no other keys; every non-placeholder brief_q_ref ∈ that list; module graph imports no BRIEF source; bundle, DOM and export contain 0 occurrences of a fixture BRIEF body string.

A10 Lint (case-insensitive, word-boundary): PnL, LIVE, tip(s), price(s), order(s), position, buy, sell, plus literals 必赚, 10000x, 买入, 卖出, 盈亏, 价格, 下单, 实盘, 荐股, 稳赚 → 0 hits over copy files, export md, chip fields, verify_clear payloads, and rendered DOM text nodes + title/alt/aria-label/placeholder/value attribute values (attribute names and CSS such as aria-live, position: not linted; this spec and lint config excluded).
A11 Filter: ?plate=L-11 → every rendered chip has data-plate=L-11; ?plate=power-s2 → only power §2 chips; displayed count = fold count; plate × status compose; reload restores; export honors filter.

A12 Export golden: fixed fixture → byte-identical md twice; filename verify-wall_<as_of>_<slugs joined by '+'>_<status>.md, ASCII only; plate then seq, open first; checkbox syntax; cleared lines carry source_url + source_date + copy.export_l05; disputed chips carry copy.disputed_by; header has as_of + standing notice; no HTML; state unchanged after export.
A13 Print emulation: controls display:none; chips break-inside: avoid; status legible in grayscale via text + glyph; footer shows as_of.
A14 a11y: axe-core 0 serious/critical; keyboard-only e2e filters, opens clear dialog, submits, exports; Esc closes; focus returns to trigger.
A15 Reduced motion: emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → computed animation-duration and transition-duration = 0s on all wall nodes.
A16 Bundle: homepage entry chunk contains no verify-wall module; homepage HTML has no preload/prefetch to the wall chunk.

A17 Network: page with cleared chips makes 0 cross-origin requests; source links carry rel=noopener noreferrer; Q-* fixture chip DOM has no key/password input, exchange-login, wallet-connect or order-ticket control.
A18 Grades: rendered grade (chip line 1) equals source plate grade byte-for-byte; no UI string defines O/M/S/C or ties a grade letter to placeholder.

A19 Bilingual: keys(copy.zh) = keys(copy.en), no empty values; every claim_summary / needed_source has both halves split by ｜; export labels and error strings (clear_blocked, clear_rollback, already_cleared, placeholder_locked, disputed_by) come from copy only — 0 hard-coded labels in UI or export code.
A20 Isolation: CI path guard — diff touches no file under /field, /campus, /ethics; no exchange, trading or wallet SDK in the dependency diff; no new L-05 event type besides verify_clear.
A21 IDs: fixture item with 2 [VERIFY] markers → 2 distinct chip ids sharing one source_ref; correction chip (cites=X) → new id, X still cleared and shows copy.disputed_by; ids stable across rebuilds.
A22 Roles: reader-role clear POST → 403, 0 events, 0 L-05 entries; clear control absent from reader DOM.
